title: Senior Product Manager (CRM & Growth)
jd_excerpt:
About Zable
 Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money .
 Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021
 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK
 Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan 
 Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot
 Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.
 The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.
 Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one
 Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
 Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting
   About the role 
 Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Zable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.
 Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.
 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
 Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do
 Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering
 Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust
 Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact
 Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency
 Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender
 Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.
 What we're looking for 
 Essential 
 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale
 Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery
 Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders
 A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features
 Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics
 Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on messaging infrastructure, deliverability and platform integrations, and clear communication across technical and commercial audiences
 Nice to have 
 Experience in financial services or another regulated industry
 Experience launching a new channel or capability end to end, such as push notifications across mobile and web
 Experience building experimentation or measurement tooling, including getting CRM and messaging data into a BI environment for analysis
 Experience mentoring other product managers or CRM specialists
 Interview process 
 A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match
 A 15-minute cognitive assessment.
 A practical exercise or case study interview with the Hiring Manager
 A culture-add interview to assess how you'd

 A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match
 A 15-minute cognitive assessment.
 A practical exercise or case study interview with the Hiring Manager
 A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation
 Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):
 VP Product & Design
 Engineering team members
 CPO interview
 Life at Zable
 The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
 Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
 Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
 Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
 Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
 Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
 Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
 Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations
 Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner. 
 Check out our Glassdoor Reviews and blog !
